name: Tyrell
source:
Tyrell is looking for purpose. He worries he is on his way to being considered for no more than cleanup jobs. What is Tyrell for anyway? When will anyone ever pick Tyrell first? He has a bit of a wrinkle in his attitude because of this. Still, he'll absorb any negative energy you toss his way. If you don't put his feelings first, he won't like you one bit. A quick fluff and he will be there to warm you up and keep you dry. But everyone in the bathroom talks, and if he finds out you are only using him for washup duties, he won't be too kind about it.
Likes: Family, Friends, Fuzziness
Dislikes: Feeling Left Out

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
